text:
Maya: quick coord — sdk PR depends on api#4123 and helm#98. target merge tomorrow morning. who can sign off on API change?
Chris: I can take api#4123 tonight, will run the contract tests. rough ETA 2hrs.
Alex: I can review the SDK surface (sdk#5110) after Chris gives a thumbs up. leaving a couple small comments already.
Sam: helm#98 looks fine but the runtime chart needs a values.yaml tweak for the new env var. I can patch if someone tells me the exact var name.
Maya: env var is REDWOOD_ENABLE_PREFETCH — added in api#4123. Sam pls add default=false in values.
Chris: contract tests passed locally, pushed one tiny fix to api#4123. tagging @Alex for compatibility check.
Alex: checked SDK against the updated API surface. one net-new parameter but backward compatible. leaving approval after CI is green.
Dev Bot: CI started for sdk#5110, api#4123, helm#98 — status page: https://ci.redwood.internal/2987 (auto update)
Maya: can we do a staggered merge? order: api -> sdk -> helm, with a 15m observation window between each.
Sam: ok to merge helm last. canary window at 08:15 PST looks good for me.
Chris: merging api#4123 in 10m, will notify here.
Alex: prepping a quick rollback plan for sdk in case of regression.
Maya: perfect. stashed release notes and update changelog in sdk#5110. ping me if anyone needs me to block the queue. :thumbsup:
Sam: will add the values patch and open a PR to helm#99 referencing this thread.
Dev Bot: api#4123 merged by Chris — build triggered.
Alex: CI green for sdk#5110, approved and merging now.
Maya: thanks all — after helm#99 is merged I'll start the canary monitor.
Sam: helm#99 opened and ready for review: https://git.redwood/helm/charts/pulls/99
Maya: leaving this thread open for post-merge observations. if any anomalies, tag #eng-oncall and escalate.
